# Asset Licenses and Provenance

Every asset shipped in this repository, where it came from, and what may be done with it.

## Policy

- Placeholder skins are procedurally generated and are NOT the real creators' skins.
- To use a real skin: place a Minecraft-compatible 64x64 (or 64x32 / HD) PNG at assets/skins/<id>.png (or user://skins/<id>.png at runtime) and update this manifest's source/license fields. Supplied files are never overwritten by tools/gen_assets.py.
- No Mojang/Minecraft game assets are included. Block textures, item models, character geometry and all audio are original, generated by tools/gen_assets.py and tools/gen_audio.py.
- This is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the Unstable Universe creators or Mojang/Microsoft.

## What is deliberately absent

- **No Minecraft/Mojang assets.** All block textures, item models and character geometry are original, generated by `tools/gen_assets.py`. The character proportions follow the well-known humanoid layout so that community skin files map correctly, but no Mojang file is included or required.
- **No creator-associated music.** All audio is synthesised from oscillators by `tools/gen_audio.py`. No track references or samples music associated with any real person.
- **No scraped assets.** Nothing was downloaded from a third-party site. The build tools generate every shipped asset from code.
